result:
I implemented round 248 (SABA-B-11b stage 2b): when grid lines are hidden at the current zoom, Snap now pauses, Alt included. My checks all passed and there is no STOP. C still has to check most of the browser rows. The report is `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-248.md`.

**What changed (exactly the 10 granted files)**
- **Code and tests (grants 1–9):** I applied B's pre-checked diff `b-round-247/precheck-scratch.diff` as is. All 9 app files are byte-identical to HEAD with that diff applied.
- **Doc 186 (grant 10):**
  - l.4 is `Completed (C round 248 PASS)`, as the task requires. It only becomes true if C passes.
  - Stage 2b is added to the approach, changed-files, problems, testing and TODO sections. The TODO now lists SABA-Q-11B-HIDDEN-SNAP and ARCH-CHECKPOINT-TEMPO-GRID.
- **End state:** HEAD is still `da8c641` and only those 10 paths are modified. The frozen, protected and root file hashes still match. No commit or push.

**Checks I ran**
- **Static:** `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and Biome on the 9 app files all passed.
- **Covering set:** 134 files, 2,073 of 2,073 tests passed. The slowest test used 29 % of its timeout, so nothing is near the 50 % STOP line.
- **Mutants:** all 10 runs, on a scratch copy outside the repo, failed exactly the rows B listed. The repo status was the same before and after.
- **Browser** (Playwright on the running `:5173` server, 1440×900 and 1280×720, 0 page errors):
  - With hidden lines, ruler clicks land on the free time.
  - With visible lines, clicks still snap.
  - Alt no longer turns on a hidden grid, but still turns on a visible one.
  - The arrow nudge goes 0 → 0.1 → 0.2 → 0.25 s.
  - The paused Snap title, grid-select title and status note match the task text word for word.
- **Browser gaps:** one musical click at 1280 is an invalid measurement (it repeats the earlier value, as in B's run). The first load at 1440 timed out on the dev server's cold start and was clean when re-run. No old-build (HEAD) comparison was run in the browser. My click positions differ from B's earlier run, and I did not trace why.

**Code review:** the code-reviewer found no Critical, High or Medium issues and scored the change 8.5/10. Its Low findings, all for B and none changed this round:
- HS3 already passes on the old code, which B knew.
- There are no unit tests for the hidden grid on marker drag, loop brace, bars ruler/tempo row, library drop or clip trim. I didn't add them because C checks that the diff matches B's exactly; this could be a test-only follow-up task.
- The tempo-seed and tempo-change statuses carry no "paused" note.
- Its architecture note proposes a later task to move the grid values into one hook. It recommends keeping the code as it is for now.

**Two outdated lines in doc 186 (not mine to edit):**
- The title still says "stages 1 and 2a".
- The architecture section (l.186–188) still says every snap path reads `gridSeconds` unchanged, which stage 2b made untrue.

**Left for C:** the clip-drag and playhead-drag halves of the hidden-snap row, the old-build comparison, resume on zoom-in, the loop brace and marker arrow keys, the full list of status signals, the status box width at 1280, the screen-text budget, the keys typed in text fields, the doc review, the export smoke test and the auth check. The purchased-copy row is blocked because the backend isn't available in the cloud.
